verbatim language lean4
  "theorem gate_flow (a b c d : Nat)"
  "    (_h : Not (And (a < b) (Or (b < c) (Or (c < d) (d + a < b + c))))) :"
  "    (forall n : Nat, n < a ->"
  "      And (Or (n < b) (Or (n + 1 < c) (n + 2 < d)))"
  "        (Exists fun m : Nat => And (m < c) (And (n + m < d) (m + n < a + b + c + d)))) ->"
  "    a + b <= a + b + c + d :="
  "  fun _ => by omega"
  ""
  "end Weir"
